items.text: To develop networking skills, reach out with honest, specific messages, ask for information before favours, offer something useful in return, follow up politely and keep notes, because networking is building trust over time and not collecting contacts.
Treat guarantees with care and protect your personal data.
Proof you can show supports an earlier path to financial freedom.
